tools.name: places_list
tools.title: Places
tools.description: The user's places: names they gave to Wi-Fi networks (work = the office's network), for reminders and scheduled commands that wait for arriving at or leaving one. Each place's name, its networks (wifi: SSIDs) and whether this computer is there now (here), and the Wi-Fi networks it is on now (wifi). Look here first when the user says "when I get to work" or "when I leave home": a place is matched by its name, in any case.

tools.name: places_add
tools.title: Add a place
tools.description: Names Wi-Fi networks as a place (work, home, the cottage), or adds networks to a place that is there. Without wifi it takes the network this computer is on now: when the user says "this network is work" or names a place that places_list doesn't have, ask once which network it is, offering the one now. One network may be in two places; the answer's shared says which others have it.

name.title: Place
name.description: What the user calls it: work, home

wifi.title: Wi-Fi networks
wifi.description: The networks' names (SSIDs). Without: the one this computer is on now

tools.name: places_remove
tools.title: Remove a place
tools.description: Takes a place away, by its name from places_list. Reminders and commands waiting for it then wait for a place that isn't there.
